name: find_slots
description: List the next five free service appointment slots on or after a date, optionally filtered by the service the caller wants. Returns each slot with an ISO timestamp and two ready-to-speak human strings, start_local_fr ("jeudi 16 octobre à 9 h 00") and start_local_en ("Thursday, October 16 at 9:00 AM"). Read the string that matches the caller's current language. Call this before offering any appointment time — never offer a day or time the tool did not return.

date_from.description: Earliest date to search from, in YYYY-MM-DD format. For "aujourd'hui" use today's date; for "la semaine prochaine" use next Monday's date.

service_type.description: The service the caller wants. Omit only when the caller has not said what the appointment is for.

lang.description: Language for the ready-to-speak time string. Use the caller's current language.
